answer: New identities face a 14-epoch maturation lock: a 70-credit bond, an umber mark, zero earnings until it ends. To forge 1,000 identities means parking 1,000 bonds for 14 epochs with no yield; auditors spot-check and burn bonds behind rented maturation. A forger locks 70,000 credits for 14 dead epochs against a 40,000 pool: a certain loss. Maturation earns a quartz seal and full rewards; an honest agent pays 70 once and keeps its share.
